subject: select2 works in ui.R but not with reactiveUI

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: select2 works in ui.R but not with reactiveUI
parts:
I have been using select2 for dropdowns in Shiny (js below). For some reason it get a nice select2-dropdown when I specify the selectInput in ui.R but it does not work when I specify the selectInput through reactiveUI.

Any ideas why this happens? Ideas for a solution?

I can make a reproducible example if that would be useful.

<link href="js/select2/select2.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="js/select2/select2.js"></script>
<script>
    $(document).ready(function() { $("#packData").select2({ width: 'resolve', placeholder: "Choose a file" }); });
</script>

See also this thread:

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/select2/shiny-discuss/09UoBQEoCv8/jMt_lUXeEGoJ

messages.author: 0b8f6965356502a5
messages.subject: Re: select2 works in ui.R but not with reactiveUI
parts:
Joe and Vincent,

Thank you guys so much for your work on getting "select2" functioning within the Shiny framework. I have been trying to figure out how to get something like this working now for over a week and I just don't have enough Javascript skills to do so. I was also attempting to get jQuery-Multiselect working within a "reactiveUI" context, but have been falling short. I realize now it comes down to the following code chunk:

and I just don't know how to compensate for it.
I would much rather utilize "select2" than "jQuery-MultiSelect" since it has the same look and feel of "native" shiny UI objects. I am glad someone else has an interest in extending the selectInput functionality beyond the basic.

Joe ... there have been a lot of good "output" extension examples in this group, such as FooTable and DataTable, but not a really solid "input" extension example. I went through the "building-input" tutorial along with Kenton Russell's d3 example in this group which extends outputs according to what is laid out on the Shiny website. However, trying to tackle the addition of some of the necessary Shiny functions within the default select2.js file is a daunting task for a javascript newbie. I think if you could provide a solid example of how to transform "select2" to a functioning Shiny component, this will open the door for so many other people to follow that example and extend other existing Javascript UI components.

Thanks so much for all you are doing with Shiny! Your work and effort is greatly appreciated.
